commands.run: osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal"' -e 'set out to ""' -e 'repeat with w in windows' -e 'repeat with t in tabs of w' -e 'set out to out & (tty of t) & (character id 9) & (custom title of t) & linefeed' -e 'end repeat' -e 'end repeat' -e 'return out' -e 'end tell' | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r tty title; do if [ -n "$tty" ]; then printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$tty" "$title" "$(ps -t "${tty#/dev/}" -o comm= | awk -F/ '{print $NF}' | grep -m1 -E '^(claude|codex|opencode|grok)$')"; fi; done

osascript - /dev/ttysNNN <<'EOF'
on run argv
  set wanted to item 1 of argv
  tell application "Terminal"
    repeat with w in windows
      repeat with t in tabs of w
        if tty of t is wanted then
          set selected tab of w to t
          set index of w to 1
          activate
          return "ok"
        end if
      end repeat
    end repeat
  end tell
  return "none"
end run
EOF
commands.replace: /dev/ttysNNN is the TTY of the tab selected in step 1
